_readme: BigCommerce pack knowledge. Both lists are a SEED (see _stamp): written from stable API-shape knowledge, to be re-verified per engagement against developer.bigcommerce.com for the store's plan tier and API versions.

target_api_endpoint_families mixes V3 Management REST paths, the remaining V2 paths (orders and legacy resources), GraphQL Storefront operations (written as 'graphql storefront:') and the separate B2B Edition API - a fit estimation must state which surface carries each requirement, because storefront-safe and admin-only data are strictly separated and rate limits differ.

target_content_component_types lists the Page Builder widget and content types a merchant sees. Widget instances are API-readable but rendered by the Stencil theme's Handlebars templates, so a headless frontend needs its own renderer per widget type.
target_api_endpoint_families: /v3/content/pages (web pages: page, link, raw HTML, contact form)
/v3/storefront/api-token and /v3/storefront/api-token-customer-impersonation (tokens for the GraphQL Storefront API)
graphql storefront: site.products / site.product / site.search.searchProducts (facets, filters), site.categoryTree, site.category, site.brands
graphql storefront: site.cart / site.checkout (+ cart mutations)
graphql storefront: customer (orders, wishlists, addresses; needs a customer-impersonation token)
graphql admin: selected admin domains (price lists, product attributes, channels) - coverage differs from V3, verify
B2B Edition API (separate host): companies, company users, quotes, invoices, shopping lists, sales staff
target_content_component_types: Page Builder widget: Product Set / featured products block
Page Builder widget: Newsletter / email capture form
Page Builder widget: Social media / share links
Custom widget (widget-template + JSON settings schema, drag-and-drop for merchants)
App-provided widget (installed app registers its own widget template)
Web Page type: standard page (WYSIWYG or Page Builder)
Web Page type: raw HTML page
Web Page type: contact form page
Storefront script (Scripts API injection, header/footer, per channel)
Product / category / brand description HTML field (unstructured content on the catalog resource)
Makeswift component (visual page building for the headless/Catalyst frontend)

_stamp.source: seed from general platform knowledge, to be verified
_stamp.verify_first: plan tier and whether B2B Edition is licensed, current API rate limits for that plan, which resources are channel-aware for multi-storefront, the shipped Cornerstone/Page Builder widget set, and the supported headless combination (Catalyst version, Makeswift)
